we present a History Aware Multmodal Transformer (HAMT), which achieves new state of art on vision-and-language navigation tasks, including R2R, Rxr, R2R-Las, REVERIE, CVDN, R2R-Bac and R4R.

1) HAMT is the first approach to VLN that can encode a long history of past panoramic observations and actions; 2) HAMT outperforms the current state of the art by a large margin on several VLN benchmarks, including R2R, RxRx, R2R-last and REVERIE; 3) We demonstrate that HAMT is particularly effective on long-horizon navigation tasks.
